data.name: Rashiq
data.gender_notes: Rashiq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is elegant and delicate in his actions and speech. The name Rashiq carries the meaning “Elegant, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Rashiq usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies the gentle and refined nature of a person, embodying the essence of kindness and grace.
data.etymology: Rashiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elegant, Delicate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rashiq total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: رشّيق
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرَشّيقُ: اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، هو الراشد، المُتَوَكّي، المُتَفَرّق. يُشبهه بالرجل الذي يَسعى في سِلاحه، ويُساوم في أَنفاسه، ويَستقيم في خُطاه. وَهو من أسماء الله الحسنى، وقد ذكره القرآن الكريم في سورة فصّلت، الآية 2. ويُستخدم هذا الاسم في إشارة إلى شخصٍ يَمتاز بالرشد، والذكاء، والمُستقيمين فيما يَعمله. ويُعتبر اسمًا شائعًا في الثقافة العربية، وَخاصة في الأوساط الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: رشّيق
in_urdu.long_meaning: الرَشّيقُ: اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک اسمِ مبارک ہے جس کا مطلب ہے راشد، متواکل، متفَرّق۔ یہ اسم اللہ تعالیٰ سے منسوب ہے جس نے قرآن میں اپنے صفات و Attributes کا ذکر کیا ہے۔ یہ نام پاکستان میں مسلمانوں کے لیے بہت مقبول ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے ایک شخص جو ہر کام میں درست ہے اور اس کے تمام اعمال میں ہم آہنگی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रशiq
in_hindi.long_meaning: रशिक़: अल्लाह का एक नाम है जिसका अर्थ है राशद, मेटवाकल, मेटफ़र्क़। यह नाम आमतौर पर मुस्लिम परिवारों में पाया जाता है और इसका अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति अपने सभी कार्यों में सही और सीधा होता है।

in_english.name: Rashiq
in_english.meaning: Rashiq: righteous, steadfast, balanced, equitable, and fair
in_english.long_meaning: Rashiq is an Arabic name that means righteous, steadfast, balanced, equitable, and fair. This name is derived from the Arabic root R-Ş-Q, which connotes balance, stability, and fairness. In Islamic tradition, Rashiq is considered one of the beautiful names of Allah, highlighting His attribute of being balanced and fair in all aspects. The name Rashiq is commonly used in many Muslim cultures and is associated with positive qualities such as integrity, justice, and equality.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rashiq" embodies the aristocratic, refined, and elegant nature of the individual. In Islamic culture, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and his companions were known for their impeccable manners and beautiful character traits. The name 'Rashiq' could be perceived as a reminder of the importance of good character and manners as a reflection of one's inner faith and belief in God. This cultural significance highlights the importance of being a good representative of Islam in public and ensuring that one's actions and speech align with Islamic values.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Rashiq" holds a deep spiritual significance as it reminds the bearer of the importance of inner beauty and elegance, as highlighted in the Quran: "And Allah is Ar-Rafi'(Exalted in Honour), the Lord of the Throne." (Al-An'am 6:101). This verse emphasizes the need for exalted consciousness and inner refinement in all aspects of life, which reflects one's faith and closeness to Allah. By striving to be 'Rashiq' in character, the individual can cultivate a beautiful soul and attract Allah's pleasure and love.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Elegant, Delicate" symbolizes One who is elegant and delicate in his actions and speech. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rashiq serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of elegant, delicate.
